title: Yo-Yo Ma Bach Cello Suite No.1 in G Major
summary: Yo-Yo Ma performs Bach's Cello Suite No. 1 in G Major at the BBC Proms in 2015. It is a full solo cello performance of the suite.
why: Offered as an entry point to Bach's cello suites, which HN commenters praise for evoking rich harmony from a single line.

quote.text: even though only one note is being played at a time, the harmonic landscape is shifting and changing
